notes.title: Bug Fixes & QoL Improvements
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441571/3754fd98104a2e45f92522990ad2b111e7c7c11e.png

First Update!

Hi SUMMERHOUSE players! 

First of all: Thank you! The launch of this game has been an incredible experience, thanks for playing my little game, thanks for telling your friends about it and thanks for sharing your creations with me and other players! I'm really grateful for how positive and friendly the community around this game has been and I'm happy to see that the majority of you seem to be having a good time with SUMMERHOUSE. 

Making a game by yourself is a pretty exhausting project and I've taken some time off to recover, but here's the first SUMMERHOUSE update! There's going to be new building blocks in future updates, but that's still going to take a moment, so thanks for being patient with me!

Here are the change notes: 

Added cross plattform Steam Cloud Save support, including for Steam Deck (users might get a one time cloud-save conflict, sorry about that, it's unfortunately unavoidable)
Implemented a tutorial for hiding the UI with "H"
Fixed "J" and "K" buttons switching maps. This was a debug option I accidentally shipped
Destruction mode gets blocked by UI elements, no more accidentally deleting blocks when clicking a button
Fixed camera shake bug that would slowly offset the camera position and could lead to camera moving outside of bounds
Fixed Steam Cloud Save support for unlocked characters
Characters unlocked in the game's demo should now count towards achievement progress
Eyedropper button switches back to random modes after picking item
Building Block Gallery remembers last scrolling position

That's it! Please continue letting me know if you find any issues in the game, I'm going to be working on the next update. 

Thanks again for being an incredibly kind community, I hope you continue to have a great time with SUMMERHOUSE! 

Cheers, 
Friedemann

notes.title: Hotfix for resolution bug
notes.content: There was a bug that caused the game to switch to an unplayable 1x1px resolution on changing any settings. This should fix it. Please let me know if the issue persists for anyone! Thanks for your support and being patient!

notes.title: Summerhouse arrives on March 8th!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441571/ffb5ef14ee4fffac4a2752d15f991e0566396864.png

Hello Summer Lovers!
Exciting news! I’m happy to say I finally have a release date for SUMMERHOUSE: the game will launch via Steam on March 8th!

Thank you for everything so far
As you may know, SUMMERHOUSE is my first ever project as a solo indie developer. Going in, I thought this would be a tiny project in between bigger team efforts as a sort of creative palette cleanser, but the love and support you have shown for my little game went above and beyond all my expectations.

Thank you so much for your encouragement and patience during the final stretch to launch. I’m really excited to share the finished game with you all in a couple weeks! <3

All the best,
Friedemann

notes.title: Thank You & Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441571/5dea796343975c5207f9280f510a789395122f20.png

Hello there, fellow architects!

First of all: Thank you so much for the amazing response to this demo so far. I'm overwhelmed by how many of you have shared their amazing creations with me and have taken time to write feedback and suggestions. Honestly: Thank you so much, you make this whole process worth all the effort! 

I'm excited to share with you the first major update for the SUMMERHOUSE demo! This update is a blend of your suggestions and some bug fixes, that will hopefully make your time with SUMMERHOUSE even more enjoyable.

New Features: 

Eye-dropper tool: Press "i" or hold "alt" or "shift" on your keyboard to quickly pick a building block that you've placed before. 
Reworked Placement Gridl: Many of you have asked for the ability to place smaller objects in finer increments. I've reworked the placement system to allow for exactly that: the smaller an object is, that finer the grid you place it on. Those annoying mailboxes should be a lot more fun to place now <3 


Quality of Life Improvements:

Flip Shortcut: Press "F" to flip blocks horizontally. 
Resolution Confirm Check: Added a safety check when resolution is changed in the settings to ensure the game doesn't get stuck in a non-supported resolution.
Error Log Button: Added button to the settings menu that opens the local directory of the game's error log which is very useful when reporting bugs. 
Toggle for Draggable Camera: A lot of you have reported that the draggable camera gets in your way more than it helps. So it's now toggled off by default and you can only move the camera with WASD or the arrow keys. For those who enjoyed it, there's a toggle in the settings to turn it back on. 


Bug Fixes:

Resolution Fixes: There are some problems with the game's resolution picking dialog. I've fixed an issue where the dialog was displaying unsupported resolutions and ordering them in the wrong way. Still working on other issues that have been reported. 
Reset Settings: Pressing the "Reset Settings" button in the settings menu would in some cases not reset them properly, that should be fixed. 
Scroll Wheel Speed: Fixed slow scroll wheel speed on Windows.


Keep building and sharing those dreamy summer retreats, it's been so exciting to see them! And please keep the suggestions, feedback and bug reports coming, I'm working hard to make the game the best it can be for the full release and every bit of feedback is very valuable to me. 

Have fun and merry Christmas to those of you who celebrate <3 

Love,
Friedemann

notes.title: SUMMERHOUSE demo is out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44441571/b300f2fdbdd4d4119c31f1689a9b8d074327315a.png

Hello builders and dreamers!

I'm thrilled to announce that the playable demo of SUMMERHOUSE is now available as part of the Wholesome Snack: TGA edition! In this little slice of the game, you'll get a taste of the atmosphere and creative freedom that SUMMERHOUSE offers.


 Build Beautiful, Lived-In Houses: Let your imagination roam free as you create cosy, gorgeous homes.
 No Pressure, Just Pleasure: There are no rules, no scores, and no competition. This is your personal canvas to paint as you wish.
 Soak in the Atmosphere: Lose yourself in the warmth of summer afternoons and the soothing sounds of your surroundings.


Since this game is still in active development, your feedback and thoughts are invaluable as I continue to shape this experience. So please share your creations, ideas, and impressions with me. I can't wait to see what you all come up with!

Happy building, hope you enjoy SUMMERHOUSE!

Love,
Friedemann
